newsitem.title: USA: WMX sees 1997 EPS of $1.75, 1998 of $2.05.
newsitem.headline: WMX sees 1997 EPS of $1.75, 1998 of $2.05.

text.p: WMX Technologies Inc expects to report earnings per share in 1997 of $1.75 and in 1998 of $2.05, said chairman Dean Buntrock.

In a copy of remarks distributed at the opening of the company's annual shareholder meeting, Buntrock said, "Although we expect little growth this year...we continue to anticipate earnings per share of $1.75 this year and $2.05 in 1998."
He also said the company expects capital spending of about $900 million this year. He added that over the next three years, the company plans to cut operating costs by $300 million.
WMX provides integrated waste management services.
